title: Discord slash command shows The application did not respond and the bot logs Unknown interaction
cause: The first response to an interaction must reach Discord within 3 seconds or the interaction token stops working. Any database or HTTP call before replying can push it past the window.
fix: Defer as the very first awaited call, do the work, then edit the reply. The token stays valid for 15 minutes for edits and followups.
affected: Discord interactions, all libraries, as of 2026-10
